content.text: In countries like Zimbabwe, where Stripe and PayPal are severely restricted, digital creators face significant hurdles in [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-get-selling-digital-products-africa-live-before|selling]] their products online. The lack of reliable payment processing systems forces them to seek alternative solutions, often leading to cumbersome workarounds that compromise their [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-github-pages-free-digital-product|COREMERCH guide to infrastructure]]-digital-creators-what-nobody-tells-20|Sovereign Commerce]]ty over their digital commerce infrastructure. This is where Google Apps Script for digital commerce automation comes into play, offering a robust and efficient way to process orders without relying on conventional platforms.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

Google Apps Script is a cloud-based platform that allows developers to create custom applications and automate tasks within the Google ecosystem. In the context of digital commerce, it can be used to create a sovereign stack that processes orders, handles payments, and delivers digital products automatically. This is particularly important for creators who cannot access traditional payment gateways, as it provides them with a reliable and efficient way to sell their products online.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind Google Apps Script for digital commerce automation involves a combination of cloud-based services, including Google Apps Script, Google Sheets, and Google Drive. When a customer makes a payment using a cryptocurrency like Bitcoin or USDT, a webhook is triggered that sends a notification to the Google Apps Script backend. This script then processes the order, generates a download link, and sends it to the customer via email. The entire process is automated, allowing creators to focus on producing high-quality content rather than managing orders manually.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is built for digital creators who are locked out of traditional payment platforms due to geographical restrictions or other limitations. It provides them with a way to sell their products online without relying on third-party platforms that may charge exorbitant fees or compromise their sovereignty. By using Google Apps Script and other cloud-based services, creators can build a robust and efficient digital commerce infrastructure that is tailored to their specific needs.
Cloudflare Workers handles 100,000 webhook events per day on the free tier.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components that make this solution work together include Google Apps Script, Google Sheets, Google Drive, and a cryptocurrency payment gateway like NOWPayments. Google Apps Script provides the backend logic, while Google Sheets serves as a database for storing orders and customer information. Google Drive is used for storing and delivering digital products, and NOWPayments handles the cryptocurrency payments. By integrating these components, creators can build a seamless and automated digital commerce workflow.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this solution today, creators can start by setting up a Google Apps Script project and connecting it to their Google Sheets database. They can then configure the script to process orders and generate download links, and integrate it with a cryptocurrency payment gateway like NOWPayments. With the right guidance and support, creators can have a fully functional digital commerce infrastructure up and running in a matter of days, allowing them to start selling their products online and reaching a global audience.
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

Automated digital product delivery works by using a webhook to trigger a script that generates a download link and sends it to the customer via email. This process is instant and efficient, allowing creators to deliver their products to customers in under 30 seconds. By using a cryptocurrency payment gateway like NOWPayments, creators can also ensure that payments are processed securely and reliably, without the need for traditional payment platforms.
A correctly configured sovereign stack processes orders in under 30 seconds.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce infrastructure, start by setting up a Google Apps Script project and connecting it to your Google Sheets database. Next, configure the script to process orders and generate download links, and integrate it with a cryptocurrency payment gateway like NOWPayments. Then, set up a cloud storage service like Google Drive to store and deliver your digital products. Finally, test your workflow end-to-end to ensure that it is working seamlessly and efficiently. By following these steps, you can build a robust and reliable digital commerce infrastructure that allows you to sell your products online with confidence.
